ideas.pitch: An AI-powered graph intelligence platform designed for university compliance and financial auditing, using gradient boosting and explainable AI to detect transactional anomalies.
ideas.title: CampusGraph AI: Institutional AML & Risk Investigation Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the proven graph intelligence and Focal LightGBM architecture from Bito to target institutional compliance use cases often favored by university-affiliated hackathon judges.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite monitoring tool tracking land use changes, green cover depletion, and construction compliance around university zones.
ideas.title: GeoNex MUJ: Satellite-Powered Campus Infrastructure & Environmental Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact technical stack and problem domain of GeoNex-ATLAS, bringing high-impact geospatial intelligence that impresses technical panels.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven nutrition assistant tailored for campus mess menus, generating personalized meal recommendations and tracking nutritional intake for students.
ideas.title: Mess-Nutri AI: Personalized Hostel Dining & Nutrition Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies the winning formula of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant to a hyper-local university problem that resonates immediately with hackathon judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI video intelligence platform that transforms unstructured lecture recordings into searchable, accessible transcripts, summaries, and Q&A knowledge bases.
ideas.title: LectureLens: AI Video Intelligence for Multi-Lingual Campus Lectures
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the LibrAI winning blueprint of unstructured data transformation, offering immediate utility to students and faculty at Manipal University Jaipur.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient acquisition and trust engine optimized for institutional dental and healthcare clinics operating within university ecosystems.
ideas.title: MediTrust AI: Patient Acquisition & Trust Engine for University Dental Clinics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the Global-Smile winning pattern of combining healthcare workflows with trust-building AI interfaces, a proven pitch for health-tech tracks.
